name: a_codes_clean
label: A codes, cleaned
description: Illustrative (the column names are made up): the V3 acceptance case, a_codes joined to another table, a column cleaned and a column added.

steps.name: Trim code
steps.sql: SELECT * REPLACE (trim(code) AS code) FROM prev

steps.name: Empty descriptions to nothing
steps.sql: SELECT * REPLACE (nullif(description, '') AS description) FROM prev

steps.name: Add the category
steps.sql: SELECT p.*, c.category FROM prev AS p LEFT JOIN code_categories AS c ON c.code = p.code

steps.name: Code prefix
steps.sql: SELECT *, upper(left(code, 2)) AS code_prefix FROM prev
